title_en: Longhai City People's Procuratorate of Fujian Province v. Yang Yizhang — intentional injury case

full_text_en:
Longhai People's Procuratorate, Fujian Province v. Yang Yizhang — intentional injury

Ruling Summary

Where an actor beats another person and causes death, the actor has already committed the crime of intentional injury. However, if the main cause of the victim's death is a serious illness from which the victim suffered before the incident, and the actor's beating is not the main cause of death but merely a trigger, the actor shall not bear full responsibility for the victim's death. In such special circumstances, if the actor does not have any statutory mitigating circumstances, the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 63 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China may be applied to impose a penalty below the statutory minimum sentence.

Criminal Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2006) Xing Fu Zi No. 121

Defendant: Yang Yizhang (nickname: Mu Dong), male, born on January 24, 1976, Han nationality, native of Longhai City, Fujian Province, educated to primary school level, farmer, residing at No. 53 Cangzai, Baitang Village, Longjiao She Ethnic Township, Longhai City. Arrested on May 28, 2005. Currently in custody.

The Longhai People's Court of Fujian Province, having tried the case where the Longhai People's Procuratorate charged the defendant at first instance, Yang Yizhang, with intentional injury, and the plaintiffs in the incidental civil action, Tian Yuhong, Liu Qingrong, Li Shihua, and Tian Chaowen, filed incidental civil claims, rendered a criminal incidental civil judgment on February 16, 2006, in (2005) Long Xing Chu Zi No. 278, finding Yang Yizhang guilty of intentional injury and sentencing him to six years of imprisonment; and ordering him to compensate Tian Yuhong and others for economic losses in the amount of RMB 76,503.43. After the judgment was pronounced, neither Yang Yizhang nor the plaintiffs in the incidental civil action filed an appeal within the statutory period, nor did the procuratorate lodge a protest. The Longhai People's Court, in accordance with the law, reported the case level by level to this Court for approval. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and conducted a review of the case. The review has now been concluded.

The review confirms: At approximately 9:00 a.m. on January 20, 2005, the defendant, Yang Yizhang, discovered that a waste collector, Tian Xueshan, had an old fishing net belonging to Yang Wangjin's family in his woven bag, beside the house of Yang Yizhang's uncle, Yang Wangjin. Yang Yizhang then beat Tian Xueshan with a wooden stick, causing multiple scattered soft tissue contusions on Tian Xueshan's arm, right shoulder, and other areas, with a total contused area of 217 square centimeters. After being injured, Tian Xueshan was sent to the hospital for emergency treatment but died at 8:00 a.m. the following day. According to forensic medical identification, the victim, Tian Xueshan, suffered before his death from serious illnesses including advanced portal cirrhosis, giant splenomegaly, and coronary heart disease. Under the triggering effect of external trauma and other factors, he died from hemorrhagic shock caused by a tear in the peritoneum connected to the liver.

The above facts are confirmed by evidence including the old fishing net seized by the public security authorities, the record of the crime scene inspection, photographs of the scene, the forensic examination report, witness testimony, and the confession of the defendant, Yang Yizhang, which he admitted without objection. The evidence is sufficient to establish the facts.

This Court is of the opinion: The defendant, Yang Yizhang, beat another person with a wooden stick and caused death, and his conduct has constituted the crime of intentional injury. However, in view of the fact that the main cause of the victim's death was the serious illness from which he suffered before his death, and that Yang Yizhang's injurious conduct was only a trigger for the victim's death, Yang Yizhang should not bear full responsibility for the victim's death. Although Yang Yizhang does not have any statutory mitigating circumstances, given the special circumstances of this case, a penalty below the statutory minimum sentence may be imposed. The facts found in the first-instance judgment are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, and the sentence is appropriate. The trial procedure was lawful. In accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 63 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 270 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

The criminal judgment of the Longhai People's Court of Fujian Province, (2005) Long Xing Chu Zi No. 278, sentencing the defendant, Yang Yizhang, to six years of imprisonment for intentional injury below the statutory minimum sentence, is approved.

This ruling shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Shen Liang

Acting Judge: Wang Weidong

Acting Judge: Song Ying

November 14, 2006

Clerk: Yang Yang

Introduction to the Presiding Judge

Senior Judge Shen Liang: Born in 1962, Master of Laws. Served as Deputy Chief Judge of the Fourth Criminal Division of the Supreme People's Court from 2005.
